 National | 2 hours ago Three more dengue patients die
 1,674 new patients hospitalised in 24hrs FE ONLINE DESK
 Published :
 Nov 21, 2026, 11:57 
 Three dengue patients died in the last 24 hours till 8:00 am today (Saturday) while 1,674 were hospitalised after being infected with the mosquito-borne disease during the same period.
 The latest fatalities have raised the country's dengue death toll to 516 this year, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the newly hospitalised dengue patients, 744 were in Dhaka Division, 93 in Mymensingh Division, 255 in Chattogram Division, 227 in Khulna Division, 146 in Rajshahi, 64 in Rangpur Division and 145 in Barishal Division, reports BSS.
 According to the report, a total of 171,954 dengue patients have, so far, been hospitalised across the country this year.
 So far, 165,864 dengue patients have recovered and returned home after receiving treatment in the hospitals.
 A total of 102,861 people were infected with dengue, and 413 people died from the mosquito-borne disease last year.
